name: Shelah
title: Judah's Son and Patriarch
summary: Shelah was the third son of Judah and his Canaanite wife Bat-Shua. He is known from Genesis as one of Judah's sons, but died young without leaving offspring, and his role is connected to the levirate marriage where his brother Onan's duty was to raise up an heir for Er, the firstborn.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Shelah
keyEvents.description: Shelah was born as the third son of Judah and his Canaanite wife Bat-Shua in Chezib.

keyEvents.title: Judah's Promise to Tamar
keyEvents.description: After Er and Onan died, Judah promised his daughter-in-law Tamar that Shelah would become her husband when he grew old enough, but Judah feared that Shelah might also die.

keyEvents.title: Judah Withholds Shelah
keyEvents.description: Judah let time pass without fulfilling his promise to give Shelah to Tamar as a husband, because he feared for his son's life.

keyEvents.title: Shelah Mentioned in Judah's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Shelah is recorded as part of Judah's lineage in the Book of Numbers, where his descendants are counted among Judah's clan.

keyEvents.title: Shelah in the Books of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Shelah is mentioned again as a son of Judah in connection with the genealogical register of Judah's tribe.
